sql:
SELECT
  ps.cluster_label,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.posting_key)
FROM fct_posting AS f
JOIN posting_skills AS ps
  ON f.posting_key = ps.posting_key
WHERE
  f.is_open = TRUE AND f.remote_us = TRUE AND f.is_canonical_listing = TRUE
GROUP BY
  ps.cluster_label;
